title: Penelope | Vintage Floral Blouse with V-Neckline
bodyHtml:
This is the blouse you'll reach for on warm days when you want to feel put-together without trying. A soft, vintage floral print brings effortless femininity, while the V-neckline sits beautifully on all shapes, skimming without clinging. Layer it with your favourite linen trousers, tie it over a slip dress, or wear it as is—it's the kind of piece that moves with you, whether you're heading to the markets or meeting friends for an afternoon drink.

Why you'll love it

  • Vintage floral print — a timeless pattern that works season after season
  • V-neckline — flattering and naturally feminine, without trying too hard
  • Short sleeves — perfect for warm weather, with just enough coverage
  • Soft, breathable fabric — light and comfortable all day long
  • Button front — easy to slip on and layer however you like
  • Versatile — dress it up or down, it's at home anywhere
  • Extended size range — designed to suit every body
